purpose: Explain tours through Natal as airport connection to Pipa, distinguish the two actual live products and prevent the SEO article from promising nonexistent Natal city excursions.

externalSources.supports: Rio Grande do Norte government descriptions of Natal, Ponta Negra, Parque das Dunas and Pipa, distinct destinations
Natal municipal tourism descriptions of Ponta Negra and Morro do Careca
Pipa geographic setting south of Natal, cliffs, beach types, low tide and dolphin-viewing context, never as tour guarantee

constraints: Only active tour MD establishes the route and services. The 13-day program explicitly excludes specified domestic airfares; the 11-day program is not assumed to share this exclusion. No city sightseeing in Natal is advertised as included. Dynamic tour count and comparison.
